== Card Text vs Glossary ruling ==
Removed "When transferring a captive to a prison, Fett modifies that captive's forfeit value for the purposes of resolving any Bounty effects." from Card Text. In the [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]] (29 January 2002) that sentence is a ruling after the ∆ substitute game text, not part of the face. Same split in Scomp (
ulings, not gametext), GEMP Card5_091, and the PC Decipher Errata slip. The sentence stays under Rulings. [[User:Admin|Admin]] ([[User talk:Admin|talk]]) 22:28, 6 November 2026 (UTC)
